test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

The speaker’s emphasiss is on the present-day problems that are being faced by ordinary men of India.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. 'The speaker’s emphasiss is' has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**emphasiss**" is incorrect and should be corrected to "emphasis".
 
• The sentence requires "**emphasis**" which is the correct spelling.
 
• "**Emphasiss**" is not a recognized word in the English language.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence should read:* "The speaker’s **emphasis **is on the present-day problems that are being faced by ordinary men of India."*

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

Additional Information

 
• **Option 1:** "that are being faced" is grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• **Option 2:** "on the present-day problems" is also correct as it indicates the focus of the speaker.
 
• **Option 3:** "by ordinary men of India" is correctly phrased and does not have any grammatical errors.
